_launch_note: TASK 14.2 EXAMPLE launch configuration for Inflapark Group (company slug 'inflapark-group'), the identity already established in apps/api/src/development/bootstrap-owner.service.ts and reused faithfully here (NOT invented). This file is a TEMPLATE, not a ready-to-run config: every literal string "REQUIRED_OPERATOR_INPUT" below MUST be replaced by a human operator with real, business-confirmed data before 'provision:business-config' is run against it — the CLI refuses to run while any such placeholder remains. IMPORTANT — branches: this file lists all six branches already established in local/dev fixtures (Puerta La Victoria, Portal Centro, Universidad, Juriquilla, CDMX, Campeche). Do NOT assume all six launch simultaneously — the operator MUST confirm, before running this tool, which of these branches (if any, or a different one entirely) is the actual FIRST launch branch, and should delete/adjust the 'branches', 'registers', 'users', and 'inventory_opening_balances' entries below to match that real decision. Pricing note: every unit_price below is copied from apps/api/src/development/seed-pos-catalog.service.ts, which is explicitly a development/QA fixture, NOT confirmed final production pricing — see each product's own "unit_price_is_confirmed_final": false marker.
_registers_note: No real register configuration exists anywhere yet for Inflapark. Each entry below defaults to exactly ONE register per listed branch ('Caja 1' / 'CAJA-1') as a sensible, clearly-labeled starting point — override the name/code, add more registers per branch, or delete entries for branches that are not actually launching, as the operator decides. The count of registers per branch is NOT a confirmed business fact.

roles.name: Owner
roles._comment: The owner role/user already exists — created by 'provision:production-owner' (TASK 14.1) with every permission currently in the permission catalogue. This entry is here for documentation completeness only; 'provision:business-config' looks it up by code, finds it already exists, and skips it (it never creates or re-creates the owner role itself — see business-config.service.ts's own doc comment for why).

roles.name: Cajero
roles._comment: Explicit permission list — never company-wide/full access. Add 'reward.read' and 'reward.redeem' to this array ONLY if this same file's rewards.enabled is true.

roles.name: Gerente
roles._comment: OPTIONAL role — create only if business policy requires manager-gated refunds. The launch default in THIS example is TRUE: cashiers do NOT self-approve refunds, this manager role does, holding the cashier permission set PLUS refund.read/refund.create/refund.approve/refund.complete. To change that policy, delete this role entry entirely and add refund.read/refund.create/refund.approve/refund.complete to the cashier role's own 'permissions' array instead (letting cashiers self-approve refunds).

_users_note: The owner user is already provisioned separately by 'provision:production-owner' — this array only ever contains NEW staff. Real display_name/email are unknown right now, so both are marked REQUIRED_OPERATOR_INPUT below; branch_code is also left as REQUIRED_OPERATOR_INPUT since the actual first launch branch has not been confirmed (see _launch_note). NEVER add a password field here — see the CLI's own --users-password-env-prefix / interactive-prompt documentation for how passwords are supplied, separately from this file.
_inventory_opening_balances_note: Stock-tracked products only (tracks_inventory=true above: TDA-CALCETAS, TDA-AGUA, TDA-REFRESCO). Quantities are marked REQUIRED_OPERATOR_INPUT — a real starting stock count must never be invented by this template.

rewards._comment: Launch default: enabled=false — do not force launch dependency on Rewards; if not enabled, provision:business-config leaves the program inactive (it creates nothing). The fields below still describe a realistic, ready-to-use template — mirroring the 'Sellos VIP (5+1)' dev fixture in apps/api/src/development/seed-loyalty-rewards.service.ts — so flipping enabled to true later is a one-line change, not a redesign.

_promotions_note: Launch with promotions empty and still operate correctly; populate only with real, business-confirmed promotions. provision:business-config does not yet create promotions — it refuses (rather than silently ignoring) if this array is non-empty.
